      "title": "Physical exam frequency at weekly visits may be burdensome",

      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Physical examination is scheduled at every visit including weekly dosing visits, which may be burdensome for patients and sites, especially when brief exams are sufficient per Section 6.1.8.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing to brief symptom-directed exams at weekly visits, with full exams only at Screening and EOT."
    },

      "title": "Vital signs at every visit may be excessive",

      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Vital signs are collected at every visit, including weekly dosing visits, which may add time and burden without clear clinical necessity.",
      "fix": "Consider limiting vital signs to visits with dosing or as clinically indicated."

    {
      "title": "ECG not listed in Schedule of Activities",
